lg.l: theg mchog zab mo'i dgongs don rnam 'byed pa'i ||
tshul 'di bla ma dam pas rjes bzung zhing ||

blo ldan slob mas yang yangThe second "yang" is not very clear in the manuscript. Its reading comes from the printed version (ID:7391)
bskul ba'i mthus ||
blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis rnam par sbyar ||
'phags pa'i gsung dang dam pa'i legs bshad dpang byas nas ||
tshig don ma lus gsal bar bshad yod de lta na'ang ||

bdag bla'i blo'i nyes pas gal te 'khrul
pa'i cha mchis na ||
de nyid gzigs pa'i mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol ||
phyogs zhen phrag dog ti °gti mug gis bsgribs pa'i ||
log sred can dag 'di yis mchu dka' mod ||

gzu bor gnas shing legs bshad
don gnyer ba'i ||
blo ldan skal ba can rnams dgyes par mdzod ||
bdag blo dang ba'i mkha' las 'ongs pa'i legs bshad nyin mor byed pa'i 'od ||
ma lus 'gro ba'i gling la shar bas mi shes mun pa'i tshogs bcom nas ||

'di ni rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams mgon nas ||
thogs med dbyig gnyen blo brtan gang ba spel ||
kha ma (che?) rin chen rdo rje sad dza na dang ni ||
pa ra hi ta blo gros grags pa dang ||
mar pa jo 'phan don grub brtson seng 'chims nam mkha' grags ||
